---
title: "Lecture Report"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    theme: readable
  pdf_document:
    toc: true
params:
  lecture_id: ""
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(lubridate)
  library(knitr)
})

# These helpers live in backend-r-plumber/R. The working dir on render is the
# Rmd's folder (reports/), so step up one level.
source("../R/config.R")
source("../R/firestore.R")
source("../R/helpers.R")
source("../R/engagement.R")

lecture_id <- params$lecture_id
lec_doc <- tryCatch(fs_get(sprintf("lectures/%s", lecture_id)), error = function(e) NULL)
lec <- if (is.null(lec_doc)) list() else fs_unwrap_fields(lec_doc$fields)

# Pull all emotions rows for this lecture.
all_docs <- fs_list("emotions")
rows <- lapply(all_docs, function(d) fs_unwrap_fields(d$fields))
df <- if (length(rows) == 0) {
  data.frame()
} else {
  bind_rows(lapply(rows, function(r) {
    atomic <- r[vapply(r, function(v) is.null(v) || (is.atomic(v) && length(v) <= 1), logical(1))]
    atomic[vapply(atomic, is.null, logical(1))] <- NA
    as.data.frame(atomic, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))
}
if (nrow(df) > 0) {
  df <- df |> filter(lecture_id == !!lecture_id) |>
    mutate(timestamp = lubridate::as_datetime(timestamp),
           engagement_score = as.numeric(engagement_score))
}
```

## Cover

- **Lecture:** `r lec$title %||% lecture_id`
- **Doctor:** `r lec$doctor_id %||% 'unknown'`
- **Status:** `r lec$status %||% 'unknown'`
- **Finalized at:** `r lec$finalized_at %||% 'pending'`
- **Observations captured:** `r nrow(df)`
- **Students seen:** `r if (nrow(df) > 0) length(unique(df$student_id)) else 0`

```{r attendance, results = "asis"}
if (nrow(df) > 0) {
  att <- df |>
    group_by(student_id) |>
    summarise(observations = n(),
              first_seen = min(timestamp),
              last_seen  = max(timestamp),
              mean_engagement = round(mean(engagement_score, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
              .groups = "drop")
  cat("## Attendance\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(att))
} else {
  cat("## Attendance\n\n*(no observations yet)*\n")
}
```

```{r engagement_chart, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 3.5}
if (nrow(df) > 0) {
  buckets <- df |>
    mutate(bucket = lubridate::floor_date(timestamp, "30 seconds")) |>
    group_by(bucket) |>
    summarise(engagement = mean(engagement_score, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  ggplot(buckets, aes(x = bucket, y = engagement)) +
    geom_line(colour = "#2a7ae2", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(colour = "#2a7ae2") +
    labs(title = "Engagement over time (30-sec buckets)",
         x = "time", y = "mean engagement") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
}
```

```{r emotion_chart, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 3.5}
if (nrow(df) > 0) {
  df |>
    count(emotion, sort = TRUE) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = reorder(emotion, -n), y = n, fill = emotion)) +
    geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
    labs(title = "Emotion distribution", x = NULL, y = "observations") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
}
```

```{r sleep_and_gestures}
if (nrow(df) > 0 && "state" %in% names(df)) {
  sleep_rate <- mean(df$state == "sleeping", na.rm = TRUE)
  cat(sprintf("## Sleep rate\n\n**%.1f%%** of observations were flagged as sleeping.\n",
              sleep_rate * 100))
}
if (nrow(df) > 0 && "gesture" %in% names(df)) {
  g <- df |> filter(!gesture %in% c("none", NA)) |>
    select(timestamp, student_id, gesture)
  if (nrow(g) > 0) {
    cat("## Gesture log\n\n")
    print(knitr::kable(g))
  }
}
```
